task_description: Build a complete RESTful CRUD API layer for all entity types (NPCs, Quests, Zones, Lore, Relationships, Dialogue Trees, Content Packs) plus a search endpoint. Uses existing createApiHandler middleware, Zod validation schemas, DB repositories, audit logging, and cache invalidation patterns.

verification.summary: bun run type-check passes (0 TS errors). bun run test:run passes all 37 tests (5 test files). Review fixes applied: DELETE/PUT handlers now check entity existence before proceeding (returning 404 if not found), and search error no longer reflects user input.
